issues.passage: Her stock analysis introduced a framework no prior study had considered.
issues.why: Valid, natural use of stock as equities: “stock analysis” is standard finance English for analyzing shares. A student who knows the word would accept the sentence under that sense, so it fails as a wrongPassage for the adjective sense “standard / not original.”

fix.correctPassage: The mayor offered a stock reply that could have applied to almost any civic dispute.
wrongPassages: Her stock conclusion was celebrated for overturning every assumption prior researchers shared.
Reviewers praised the stock plot for abandoning every familiar narrative pattern.
He delivered a stock argument so idiosyncratic that colleagues could not place it.
